answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the delta check immediately, the grove audit keeps the resolved set and the inlet replay makes public exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 195 aliases thus pays the reading cost 195 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
